Definition: from σκέπτομαι (to peer about ("skeptic"); perhaps akin to G4626 through the idea of concealment; compare G4629); a watch (sentry or scout), i.e. (by implication) a goal:--mark.
BiblicalUsage: Skopos is the mark, the goal, the target, and it appears once, where Paul says he presses toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the mark is Christ Himself, because Paul pressed toward a Person, not a prize, and the prize was the calling that came with Him.
